eps.o: During a festival celebrating the demise of the Avatar, one orphan girl struggles to stay hidden until she crosses paths with a dutiful airbender.
When a massive storm hits Ellora, Team Avatar unites to save their home and are confronted by a strange entity.
Being the Avatar is a lot of responsibility! Pavi is overwhelmed and misses her friends. Jae stumbles upon a secret organization and must make a life-altering decision.
Team Avatar sets out to find a missing bender, leading them into a dangerous confrontation with a ruthless gang of bandits.
While Jae and Karthik investigate brewing rumors that actively endanger the girls, Pavi and Nisha sneak into Karthik's office to uncover hidden answers about their parents.

Karthik, Nisha, and Pavi must work together to quell a mass panic among the Afflicted inside the hospital. Meanwhile, Jae is forced to deal with a rising wave of unrest brewing within the Bending Brigade.
Pavi, Nisha, and Jae uncover a pre-Cataclysm facility beneath Ellora containing a long-dormant time capsule with ancient secrets.
Ellora hosts Envoys from other Havens with hopes to receive aid from their estranged neighbors. Nisha takes a Trial to determine her future as an Avatar, while Pavi looks for clues about her past.
When the Haven Envoys are attacked, Nisha reveals herself as the world's protector, the Avatar. Meanwhile, Pavi desperately fights an Anomaly beneath Ellora.
